description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of a rocky island shore: wet dark stones, patches of sand, a few small shells and strands of seaweed, a thin line of foam along one edge, muted very dark palette of grey-teal, sand and dark green, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
